module: Flowgraph node 'Chainflow Branch' (logic category). Variant of Branch for 'chain flow' (pins declared with chainFlow=true): sends the flow to True or False depending on the bool pin 'condition'. No general 'flow' output pin.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: If flow is true: True = condition and False = not condition; otherwise True and False go to false.
